basis: frozen input assembly for the six-segment titanium wedge cord grip; saved before-state data copied from the accepted R3-I028 records (read as data, never imported or executed); new inputs are the adopted design freeze. All rules below are fixed before any calculation.

sourcePins.note: R3-I031 archive is an UNREVIEWED archive with all nine findings open; it is not a before-state and none of its outputs enter this baseline

cord.identity: UHMWPE-class (Dyneema-type) assumption carried unchanged from the accepted record

aluminium.identity: machined 6061-T6-class ASSUMED record carried unchanged; 150 MPa is the chosen working normal-stress limit with no hidden second factor

titanium.identity: Ti-6Al-4V ASSUMED record carried unchanged; used for wedges, cap bolts/nuts/washers, stud, stud nuts, stud bearing washers and receiver plate

resinPotRemoved.identity: historical resin pot record retained only to price its removal; no bond credit is taken in the new construction

sf12Historical.verdict: historical FAIL (separate d60+d20 construction); substitution into it is UNCOMPUTED/UNKNOWN

complianceComparators.status: I028 n=5 declared-model packets carried unchanged as labelled historical comparators; NOT rescaled through the new construction; chord-basis historical; full n=2..12 class bounds, global stability and centroid sensitivity UNKNOWN

i036GeometryMm.frame: local right-handed per end: z along cord centreline, z=0 free-cord exit plane, +z into the fitting towards the receiver; mirrored ends carry their own frame directed away from the free span; x on the first cap-bolt axis

pricedStockAssumptions.studNutHexAfRule: ASSUMED priced stock: stud-nut hex across flats = 1.6 x stud nominal (22.4 mm d60, 36.8 mm d180/11); heights are the frozen N; threaded bore priced at stud nominal; the freeze fixes heights only, so the across-flats rule is a declared assumption, not a qualified fact
pricedStockAssumptions.hexPrismAreaRule: regular hexagon area = (sqrt(3)/2) x across-flats squared, used for all hex heads and nuts
pricedStockAssumptions.blankRule: every threaded blank (cap bolts, stud) is priced as a full cylinder at its nominal diameter over its paid length; thread debit is zero and thread capacity is UNKNOWN
pricedStockAssumptions.nutBoreRule: cap-bolt nut and stud-nut bores are priced at the mating nominal diameter
pricedStockAssumptions.lumpIdentity: interface/seal/handling stock assigned as a separately identified lump at the fitting assembly centre; covers the explicit insulating sleeves/annuli/washers and handling stock; sufficiency UNKNOWN; geometric occupancy of isolation parts is listed separately at zero separate mass

axialStackDeclaration.rule: cap actual front = z_c + 0.5 (isolated assembly); all downstream positions use actual values; intervals below are the determinate consequences of the frozen datums, identical to those the calculator derives
axialStackDeclaration.capBoltSeatCheck: the cap-bolt head-side Ti washer annulus must lie within actual flange material (inside flange OD, outside the chamber bore); the calculator verifies and reports it

cordIdentity.rule: L_total = L_free + (L+8mm) end A + (L+8mm) end B; the tail is paid cord, not an extra spring; the identity is reconciled against the recorded mean/free cord lengths before any total is reported

recordedImpliedEmbeddedPerEndM.derivation: meanCordM - lFreeMeanM divided by two equals 0.136000 m / 0.210000 m per family, i.e. exactly 2x(L+8mm); the recorded datum already carries the drawn embedded runs, so no extra run and no unrecorded length increase arise

screens.status: dimensional elastic metal screens, CONDITIONAL model outputs only; none is a proof; the entire cord/grip/receiver compliance and take-up stay UNKNOWN

declaredModels.coneNormalForce: frictionless cone equilibrium: total cone normal N = T/sin(5 deg) reacted by six segments; the cord must supply the axial balance through contact friction, so the required cord-face friction coefficient is reported as tan(5 deg); available friction is UNKNOWN
declaredModels.segmentContactPressures: mean pressures over each segment's real contact areas: inner cylindrical face (58/360 x pi x D x L) and outer conical face (58/360 x pi x mean cone diameter x slant length L/cos(5 deg)); cord crushing/fibre damage UNKNOWN
declaredModels.bodyHoop: nominal thin-wall screen at the chamber-entrance plane: mean cone-face radial pressure applied at the cone big-end radius against the local wall (body OD/2 minus cone big-end radius); labelled nominal, not a contact solution
declaredModels.capBending: radial-strip upper-bound screen in the declared heritage shape: sigma = 6T(a - r_w)/(2 pi r_w t^2) with a = bolt-circle radius, r_w = stud bearing washer outer radius, t = cap thickness; known-conservative, not a plate solution
declaredModels.studTension: nominal blank-section tension T/(pi d^2/4) at the fitting demand; thread-root capacity UNKNOWN
declaredModels.plateBearing: mean bearing under one stud bearing-washer annulus at the fitting demand; plate/anchor transfer UNSIZED/UNKNOWN
declaredModels.isoLayerCompression: mean compression over the flange/cap isolation layer actual material overlap minus bolt holes; covered by the lump, occupancy only

screens.loads: fitting demand T = TfitkN and set-point T0 = T0kN carried independently from the accepted saved values; no second fitting factor is applied

newRowsPerEnd: six Ti wedge segments (exact conical-shell sector solids, 58 deg azimuth each)
one Al body with integral flange (constant-OD cylinder + conical bore + chamber bore + flange annulus, minus four bolt holes through the flange)
one Al cap (cylinder minus four bolt holes and central stud bore)
four Ti cap bolts (blank under-head length + separate hex head stock)
four Ti cap nuts (hex minus bore)
eight Ti cap washers (two per bolt)
one Ti stud blank (front/rear endpoints as declared)
three Ti stud nuts (interior + two receiver nuts, hex minus bore at the assumed across-flats)
one Ti receiver plate (annulus at central clearance)

removalCandidatesConditionalOnly.reconciliation: machining rows are 3% of the accepted Al body masses; their family sum must equal the accepted machining stock 0.23525614743131826 t to within 1e-09 t
removalCandidatesConditionalOnly.zeroQualifiedRetirement: the second bill credits no removal at all; qualified retirement is zero by issue

ledgerRules.retained: cord at recorded identity, clips, anchor blocks, doubler pads, attachment bolts, old exterior jam nut, retained anchors/receiver interface and pressure structure, retained protection provision, assembly line
ledgerRules.vehicleConvention: accepted accounting carried exactly: deltaHardwareT = new hardware + new provisions (machining, new lump) minus removals (conditional bill only); assemblyShareOnIncrementT = 0.05 x deltaHardwareT added to the assembly line once; sockets line moves by deltaHardwareT; total moves by deltaHardwareT + assemblyShare; spokes line moves with the total; margins move oppositely; lift and gas counted once, unchanged
ledgerRules.x15Scenario: 0.5 x (new sockets line + anchor blocks 6.17 + doubler pads 2.86 + attachment bolts 1.41, the latter three at stored two-decimal precision) x 1.05, reported against the new sea-level margin with the stored inherited increment disclosed
ledgerRules.centreRule: every new component's centre is the mass centroid of its own priced solid in the local frame (x=y=0 by symmetry except cap-bolt hardware at its four bolt-circle azimuths 0/90/180/270 and wedge segments at their azimuth midplanes); the isolation/handling lump sits at the fitting assembly centre (mass-weighted centroid of the per-end new hardware)

unknowns: cord contact: crushing, fibre damage, grip friction/slip, seating, creep, retention under unload, service preload
metal friction on the cone and its scatter; segment load-sharing equality is a symmetry assumption, not demonstrated
receiver-plate transfer into the unchanged anchor/block/frame: UNSIZED/UNKNOWN; extra adapter or reinforcement is a named positive unknown provision, not zero
compliance and take-up of the whole cord/grip/receiver chain: UNKNOWN; I028 n=5 packets are unchanged labelled comparators only
rear insertion, nut access, wrench clearance, station-pitch fit, added envelope/access: explicit checks absent, UNKNOWN
thread capacity, fatigue, wet/creep service, galvanic sufficiency beyond the declared provisions: UNKNOWN
SF1.2 substitution into the separate d60+d20 construction: UNKNOWN; the nominal mass delta is not its result
machining/assembly provisions and the lump are declared allowances, not measured stock; sufficiency UNKNOWN
boundary: one pure-Python process, stdlib only; frozen inputs; exact solid geometry and closed-form integrals; no ancestor import or execution; no solver, search, optimisation, render or alternate construction; failure is an acceptable honest result
